short: the token ' Hay' in a name
notes: Card: ' Hay' x9, 'Hay' x3, ' (' x2, 北京市, 'ő', '8'. Probes: ' Hay' 0.58-0.60, 'Hay' 0.50; whole-token ' Hayes' 0.05, ' hay' 0.07, 'Hey' 0.02, ' Tak' 0.01. 北京市 reached 0.73 and ' (' on the card is unexplained, so this covers part of the pole only. One near miss uses ' Hay' outside a name, so the 'in a name' part rests on one item. Output promotes ' Tu', ' past', 'imus', not explained.
